founderNote.title: A note from
letter: I started Weekend MVP to close the gap between “I have an idea” and “here’s a live URL.” Most people with a day job don’t lack ideas or talent. They lack a small enough place to start.
So every idea here is researched, sized for a weekend, and paired with prompts for the AI tools you already use. Pick one. Build it on Saturday. Show someone on Sunday.
founderNote.biography: Founder, Weekend MVP · runs a community of 400+ weekend builders

faqs.question: Do I need to code?
faqs.answer: No. Every Weekend MVP idea ships with copy-paste prompts for AI builders like Cursor, Claude, Bolt, and Lovable. You pick an idea, paste the prompts, and follow a three-screen MVP (landing → input → output). Coding helps, but it’s not required to get a demo live by Sunday.

faqs.question: Do I have to quit my job?
faqs.answer: No. Most ideas are scoped to about 8–12 hours — roughly one weekend around a 9-to-5. The site is built for solo founders and side builders who want a live URL and early users, not a sabbatical or a co-founder.

faqs.question: Are the ideas free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Browsing the idea library is free. Some full research pages ask for an email to unlock deeper prompts and sources. The Weekend MVP Starter Kit (scorecard, 48-hour plan, templates) is also free.

faqs.question: How do I build an MVP in a weekend?
faqs.answer: Pick an idea small enough for 8–12 hours, cut it to three screens (landing, input, output), and paste the prompts into an AI builder like Cursor, Claude, Bolt, or Lovable. Build on Saturday, deploy, and put the live link in front of real users on Sunday. The free Starter Kit includes a 48-hour plan.
